scenes.title: Hook
scenes.purpose: Pose the contrast: two walkers, same random rule, one certain to get home, one maybe never.
scenes.visual: Two stacked panels. A 2D lattice with a blue walker and an isometric 3D lattice with an amber walker both trace real seeded walks with step counters while the two statements land.

layout.portrait: Title block on top, man panel, bird panel, all inside the safe area.

scenes.title: The Man
scenes.purpose: A real 2D walk drifts, loops and returns to the door at step 286; the expected wait is infinite.
on_screen_text: Every step: N, S, E or W.
scenes.visual: City-grid lattice with a green door at the origin, blue leading dot with persistent trail, compass that flashes N/S/E/W, mono step counter, pulse ring when the walker reaches home.

layout.portrait: Header, 600x600 lattice stage, readouts for dimension, step and returns.

scenes.title: The Bird
scenes.purpose: A real 3D walk flies away; a 12-bird simulation shows only about a third come home (p = 0.3405).
scenes.visual: Isometric lattice with an amber leading dot, ground shadow and drop line; the camera pulls back to 12 seeded birds drawn until first return (green) or 3000 steps (red), then the tally and the exact probability.

layout.portrait: Header, isometric stage, readouts then tally.

scenes.title: The Theorem
scenes.purpose: State Polya's 1921 theorem as a table of dimension, verdict and return probability.
on_screen_text: Random walk on the lattice ℤᵈ
scenes.visual: Five-row table with verdict badges and probability bars that grow row by row; caveat line: unbiased, independent steps, infinite lattice.

layout.portrait: Header, five rows filling the stage.

scenes.title: Why
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism: home-odds decay like 1/n (2D) and n^(-3/2) (3D); one sum diverges, the other converges.
scenes.visual: Two stacked log-scale plots from exact computed values: home-odds curves for d=2 and d=3, then the running sum where blue climbs without bound and amber flattens at 0.516.

layout.portrait: Header, plot A, plot B, verdict chips.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.purpose: Land the takeaway with the attributed Kakutani line and the two outcomes; hold.
on_screen_text: A drunk man will find his way home, but a drunk bird may get lost forever.
Idealised model: unbiased, independent steps on an infinite lattice.
scenes.visual: Quote reveals word by word with man in blue and bird in amber; two chips hold miniatures of the two walks drawn earlier; slow drift through the hold.
